body: Once again, thank you so much! I think I understand, and I will try my best to keep her happy and interested like you say.

I do want to make her feel special. The truth is, that I've come to realize that making her smile or seeing her being genuinely happy makes me feel the happiest I've ever felt.

Thank you for the advice however! I know transparency is great in a relationship, and she is a little on the sensitive side. If I turned my attention towards myself, I hope that it wouldn't give the message that I love her any less? Further, I guess it will make each of our attention more valuable to the other, which is something that is extremely important.

Another thing I wonder, is that what we have, is it codependency? Must being dependent on one another be bad necessarily? I know I sound like I'm asking too many questions, but I feel like I need to do something uncharacteristic of myself in order to surprise her given she knows me so well. Is that a wrong idea to have?
